source: Railway Query.bucketS3Credentials for two exact, independently selected bucket instances

independentContracts.supports: Virtual-hosted addressing places the bucket in the endpoint hostname. Older buckets may require path addressing. This documentation describes semantics, not an exhaustive API string enum.
Virtual addressing uses bucket.endpoint/key; path addressing uses endpoint/bucket/key.
The published example uses virtual, which remains accepted alongside the observed native virtual-host spelling.
